getApp.body.en:
Reporting waits and problems is only available in the PickupRadar mobile app.

The preview on this website is read-only.
getApp.body.text:
Gutanga raporo y’igihe cyo gutegereza n’ibibazo bishoboka gusa muri porogaramu ya telefone ya PickupRadar.

Igaragaza ry’agateganyo kuri uru rubuga ni iryo kureba gusa.

getApp.cityAlert.en:
Get a launch alert when {city} goes live.

Launch alerts are set up in the mobile app.
getApp.cityAlert.text:
Menyeshwa {city} nitangira gukora.

Imenyesha ry’itangira rishyirwaho muri porogaramu ya telefone.

getApp.cityRequest.en:
Ask for PickupRadar in your city.

City requests are sent from the mobile app.
getApp.cityRequest.text:
Saba PickupRadar mu mujyi wawe.

Ubusabe bw’imijyi bwoherezwa muri porogaramu ya telefone.

saved.appOnly.text: Kubika ahafatirwa ibicuruzwa biboneka muri porogaramu ya telefone.
